resources.string: Your website address and site data will be kept.
The website is taking too long to respond. Check your connection, retry, or update its address in Settings.
The website returned HTTP %1$d. Retry later or update its address.
The website\'s security certificate could not be verified. The connection was blocked. Check your TV\'s date and the website address.
Android WebView stopped. Select Retry to recreate the browser, or update Android System WebView on your TV.
Remote navigation is not ready. Reload the page or update Android System WebView.
External page blocked. If the site moved, enter its new address in Settings.
A pop-up was blocked. Use the controls inside the current page.
Downloads are not supported in this TV app.
Website access to camera, microphone and other device permissions is disabled.
Update Android System WebView for remote navigation inside embedded players. Main-page navigation is still available.
Android System WebView is unavailable. Install or enable it in your TV settings, then reopen the app.
Your remote is all you need

Arrow keys: move the green focus outline and scroll rows.
OK: select. On a text field, OK opens native text entry.
On sliders, Left/Right adjusts the value; Up/Down leaves the slider.
Back: close a player submenu, leave fullscreen, then go back.
Menu or hold OK: open app controls from anywhere.
Up at the top of a page: return to the app toolbar.
Play/Pause and seek keys: control an HTML5 video when available.

Player opens playback actions, servers, subtitles and player settings. In a focused embedded player, Back returns to its parent page. Subtitle files open Android's document picker if your TV provides one.

Settings lets you change the HTTPS website address. This is an independent TV browser, not an official Cinejoy app. The site and its content are not bundled. Only access content you are authorized to watch.
Change the website address here if its domain moves. No app update is needed when the site keeps the same layout.
Could not save settings. Check the TV\'s available storage and try again.
This signs you out and deletes this app\'s website cookies, local lists, preferences and browsing cache. Your saved website address stays unchanged.
Could not record the data reset. Try again before clearing website data.

The app has no analytics or account service of its own. The website and embedded providers may use cookies, tracking and advertising. Third-party cookies are enabled for player compatibility. Pop-up windows, downloads and external app launches are blocked. Only enter addresses you trust.
Your TV has no document picker. Install a compatible file manager or use the website\'s online subtitles.
Only a file chosen through Android\'s document picker can be opened.
The remote-navigation script could not be loaded. Reinstall the app.
